channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: XRPL patches overflow flaw that could mint spendable XRP
item.description: XRPL’s 3.4.1 release blocks an order-book arithmetic overflow that could mint spendable XRP, after validators upgraded ahead of a public disclosure.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as CLARITY Act stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six receiving $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act stall leaves market rules unresolved.

item.title: ESMA sets three-month deadline for legacy stablecoin exposures
item.description: ESMA says EU supervisors should end services for non-MiCA stablecoins, requiring legacy exposures cleared within three months while narrowly allowing exits.

item.title: Fairshake targets 32 House races with crypto spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for November support, including six with $1 million each, after Senate efforts to advance the CLARITY Act failed.

item.title: ESMA tests tokenised collateral against CCP default risks
item.description: ESMA has opened a consultation on tokenised assets in CCP collateral workflows, putting default-time liquidity, legal enforceability and settlement finality in focus.

item.title: Thailand SEC sets Oct. 16 start for bitcoin, ether ETF rules
item.description: Thailand’s SEC has issued 11 rules effective Oct. 16, opening local exchange-traded bitcoin and ether funds under passive, custody and investor-protection requirements.

item.title: New York Permanently Bars Alex Mashinsky From Crypto Industries
item.description: New York’s settlement permanently bars Alex Mashinsky from securities, commodities and crypto business, with up to $35 million tied to federal forfeiture and prison terms.

item.title: ESMA Sets Three-Month Wind-Down for Non-MiCA Stablecoins
item.description: ESMA says EU crypto providers should block access to stablecoins outside MiCA and regulators should resolve existing client exposures within three months.

item.title: Umia raises $6.11 million in UMIA token auction
item.description: Umia says its seven-day UMIA auction raised $6.11 million at an $18 million FDV, funding a platform that links project treasuries and governance to tokens.

item.title: OKX Adds Four Investors at a $25B Pre-Money Valuation
item.description: OKX says Circle, QRT, Ripple and SC Ventures joined its funding at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, extending the ICE-led round without disclosing proceeds.

item.title: Wormhole bridge support depends on the asset route
item.description: A chain pair is only the first check: Wormhole transfers also depend on the asset, route, destination token and contracts deployed on both chains for that path.

item.title: Glamsterdam Goes Live on Ethereum’s Sepolia Testnet
item.description: Ethereum activated Glamsterdam on Sepolia on Oct. 6, testing ePBS, block access lists and revised state gas rules before Hoodi or mainnet dates are set.

item.title: syncswap in five decisions: swap, troubleshoot, add liquidity
item.description: Choose a pool, set an execution bound, diagnose failed transactions and weigh liquidity exposure before using syncswap for a swap or deposit.

item.title: Fairshake targets 32 House races after CLARITY Act stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for 2026 support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act effort remains stalled.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after CLARITY Act stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support and earmarked $6 million for six, tying campaign spending to a stalled market-structure bill.

item.title: OKXICE outlines 24/7 tokenized stock venue on XLayer
item.description: OKXICE has outlined a permissioned, 24/7 venue for tokenized US shares on XLayer; its notice details the AMM design, issuer objections and risks.

item.title: How Treasuries Should Record Polygon PoS Bridge Transfers
item.description: A bridge transfer creates linked records on two chains, often at different times; treasuries should track the source, destination and proof as one movement.

item.title: Four Checks for Crypto Listings With Case-Variant Symbols
item.description: Case-variant symbols can hide duplicate token pages or distinct assets; compare chain-qualified identifiers first, then verify metadata and market records before merging.

item.title: How Long a Polygon PoS Bridge Withdrawal Takes
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal usually takes hours: the burn must enter an Ethereum checkpoint, then a separate exit transaction releases the original assets.

item.title: When a Swap Quote Goes Stale, Requote Before Signing
item.description: A swap quote is a snapshot, not a promise: refresh it, inspect the new minimum output and route, then sign only the transaction you intend to execute.
